sample_unit: clinical burn photographs (5 repeated runs per model)

links.outcome: Inter-run reproducibility (Fleiss' kappa) of MLLM burn assessments across five repeated runs
links.effect: Inter-run reliability ranged from slight (κ = 0.171) to almost perfect (κ = 0.916); no model combined high accuracy and high reliability.
links.quote: Inter-run reliability (Fleiss' κ) ranged from slight (κ = 0.171) to almost perfect (κ = 0.916), demonstrating response variability not captured by single-query evaluations.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability, and error patterns of multiple multimodal LLMs on burn assessment using a repeated-inference benchmark study without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
